record.bible_text: Bless<WH01288><WTH8761> the LORD<WH03068>, O my soul<WH05315>. O LORD<WH03068> my God<WH0430>, thou art very<WH03966> great<WH01431><WTH8804>; thou art clothed<WH03847><WTH8804> with honour<WH01935> and majesty<WH01926>.

O LORD<WH03068>, how manifold<WH07231><WTH8804> are thy works<WH04639>! in wisdom<WH02451> hast thou made<WH06213><WTH8804> them all: the earth<WH0776> is full<WH04390><WTH8804> of thy riches<WH07075>.
<FI> So is<Fi> this great<WH01419> and wide<WH07342><WH03027> sea<WH03220>, wherein <FI>are<Fi> things creeping<WH07431> innumerable<WH04557>, both small<WH06996> and great<WH01419> beasts<WH02416>.

These wait<WH07663><WTH8762> all upon thee; that thou mayest give<WH05414><WTH8800> <FI>them<Fi> their meat<WH0400> in due season<WH06256>.
<FI> That<Fi> thou givest<WH05414><WTH8799> them they gather<WH03950><WTH8799>: thou openest<WH06605><WTH8799> thine hand<WH03027>, they are filled<WH07646><WTH8799> with good<WH02896>.

The glory<WH03519> of the LORD<WH03068> shall endure for ever<WH05769>: the LORD<WH03068> shall rejoice<WH08055><WTH8799> in his works<WH04639>. <RF>endure: Heb. be<Rf>

Let the sinners<WH02400> be consumed<WH08552><WTH8735> out of the earth<WH0776>, and let the wicked<WH07563> be no more. Bless<WH01288><WTH8761> thou the LORD<WH03068>, O my soul<WH05315>. Praise<WH01984><WTH8761> ye the LORD<WH03050>.<CM>
